topPRs.title: test(contracts): add revert tests for Preinstalls library functions
topPRs.author: devin-ai-integration
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Adds test coverage for the revert paths in `Preinstalls.getDeployedCode()` and `Preinstalls.getName()` when called with unknown addresses. These error conditions were previously untested.

**Changes:**
- Added `Preinstalls_Harness` contract to expose internal library functions for external calls (required for `vm.expectRevert()` to work correctly)
- Added `Preinstalls_GetDeployedCode_Test` with revert test for unknown address
- Added `Preinstalls_GetName_Test` with revert test for unknown address
- Updated `Preinstalls_TestInit` to instantiate the harness in `setUp()`

All 21 tests pass (19 existing + 2 new).

## Review & Testing Checklist for Human

- [ ] Verify the error message strings in tests match exactly with `src/libraries/Preinstalls.sol` lines 143 and 164
- [ ] Confirm the harness deployment in `setUp()` doesn't cause issues for existing tests (run `just test-dev --match-path test/libraries/Preinstalls.t.sol`)

### Notes

Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/655e2b43bd1341e9b6bb3b73ad8a2b0a
Requested by: Ariel Diaz (@aliersh)

topPRs.title: fix(op-node): fix safe head debounce
topPRs.author: bearpebble
topPRs.body:
**Description**
I applied the debouce FCU PR https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18234 to our fork, enabled debug logs on op-node and ran a devnet. I noticed that I was still getting FCU calls for every block in a batch, so no debouncing whatsoever. After looking at the code and the original PR https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/17901, I noticed there was likely a mistake with applying the changes and the line that should replace `e.needFCUCall` was added without replacing it.

So the current version still performs an FCU on every safe head update instead of buffering them.
